newsitem.title: HONG KONG: S'hai Hai Xing up on asset injection hope.
newsitem.headline: S'hai Hai Xing up on asset injection hope.

text.p: Shares of Shanghai Hai Xing Shipping Co Ltd jumped on speculation of possible future asset injections into the company following a group restructuring of its parent, brokers said on Wednesday.

"It was speculated that its parent would inject assets into the company after a group restructuring and that would improve the earnings of the loss-making company in future," said a sales director at a European brokerage.
The company's shares, which have gained HK$0.36 or 31.3 percent in the last two trading days, were up another HK$0.03 to HK$1.54 in late morning after touching a year high of HK$1.62.
Volume was 97.75 million shares worth HK$153.37 million.

The company said earlier that China's Ministry of Communications proposed to set up a holding company to be named China Shipping Group, of which its 56.45 percent controlling shareholder, Shanghai Shipping (Group) Co, would be a member.
The other two members would be Guangzhou Shipping (Group) Co and Dalian Shipping (Group) Co, which are state-owned enterprises under the direct supervision of the Ministry.
Last week, the shipping company reported a loss of 157.47 million yuan for 1996, compared with a profit of 37.65 million yuan in 1995.
